title: How the order notification text is built

steps.title: Entry: the order arrives
steps.content:
`buildOrderNotification` receives the whole order. The whole text is built in this function; the others are helpers.

Look at `order.couponCode`: it decides whether "you saved" shows up later.

highlights.note: the whole notification is built here

steps.anchorText: const subtotal = lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.total, 0);
steps.title: Subtotal per line
steps.content:
Each item becomes a line with `total = unitPrice × quantity`.

The subtotal does **not** include the discount yet.

steps.title: Formatted amount
steps.content:
`formatAmount` uses `Intl.NumberFormat` with the `en-US` locale, so the amount comes out as `$108.00`.

The discount text only shows up when `pricing.discount > 0`.

steps.title: Final notification text
steps.content:
The `body` combines the customer name, the number of lines, the amount and the discount text.

This is the text the test checks.
watches: `Hi ${order.customer.name}, your order of ${lines.length} items for ${amountText}${discountText} is on its way.`
